facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus is a sauropod dinosaur that lived during the Late Jurassic in Argentina.
facts.quote: Tehuelchesaurus () is a genus of macronarian or turiasaurian sauropod dinosaur from the Late Jurassic (Oxfordian to Tithonian) of Argentina.

facts.statement: The genus name honors the Tehuelche people, who are native to the Chubut province of Argentina where the fossils were found.
facts.quote: It is named in honor of the Tehuelche people, native to the Argentinian province of Chubut, where it was first found.

facts.statement: A moderately large sauropod, possibly 15 meters long, was found in the Late Jurassic Cañadon Calcareo Formation in Patagonia, Argentina.
facts.quote: It was a moderately large (possibly 15 m long) cetiosaur-like sauropod found in the Late Jurassic (Tithonian) Cañadon Calcareo Formation at Fernandez Estancia, Chubut Province, Patagonia, Argentina

facts.statement: All dorsal vertebrae of Tehuelchesaurus possess pseudopleurocoels and opisthocoelous centra, distinguishing it from Barapasaurus and Patagosaurus.
facts.quote: all the dorsal vertebrae have pseudopleurocoels (deep depressions in the centra but without internal chambers) and opisthocoelous centra, unlike in Barapasaurus and Patagosaurus.

facts.statement: Based on bone measurements including a 1.14 m humerus and 1.53 m femur, the animal was estimated to be about 15 meters long.
facts.quote: based on other proportions (humerus 1.14 m long; femur 1.53 m long; scapula 1.75 m long; ischium 1.01 m long; ilium 1.12 m; pubis 94.3 cm long), Tehuelchesaurus was probably about 15 m long.

facts.statement: The species was named by Rich, Vickers-Rich, Gimenez, Cuneo, Puerta, and Vacca in 1999.
facts.quote: It was named by Rich, Vickers-Rich, Gimenez, Cuneo, Puerta & Vacca in 1999.

facts.statement: The type species is named Tehuelchesaurus benitezii in honor of Aldo Benitez, who discovered the holotype.
facts.quote: The type species is Tehuelchesaurus benitezii (), named after Aldo Benitez, who discovered the holotype.

facts.statement: A 2019 analysis by Mannion et al. classified Tehuelchesaurus as a basal member of Turiasauria.
facts.quote: An equal weights analysis of Eusauropoda by Mannion et al. (2019) found that Tehuelchesaurus was a basal member of Turiasauria.

facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus lived during the Late Jurassic, approximately 155 to 147 million years ago, in what is now South America.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 155 y 147 millones de años, entre el Kimmeridgiense y Titoniense, en lo que hoy es la Sudamérica.

facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus measured approximately 15 meters in length, 6 meters in height, and weighed an estimated 10 tonnes.
facts.quote: Tehuelchesaurus medía aproximadamente 15 metros de largo y 6 de alto, con un peso estimado de unas 10 toneladas.

facts.statement: Skin impressions reveal that Tehuelchesaurus was covered by flat, hexagonal scales arranged adjacently to form a rosette pattern, unlike the overlapping scales of modern lizards.
facts.quote: revelan que Tehuelchesaurus estaba cubierto por escamas planas de contorno hexagonal que no se imbricaban como en los lagartos actuales, sino que se ubicaban adyacentes entre sí formando una figura de roseta.

facts.statement: All presacral vertebrae of Tehuelchesaurus are opisthocoelous.
facts.quote: Todas las vértebras presacras son opistoceleas

facts.statement: The humerus is described as short and robust, with strongly expanded ends and a thin middle shaft.
facts.quote: El húmero es más bien corto y robusto, con ambos extremos fuertemente expandidos y un eje medio delgado

facts.statement: Fossil remains of Tehuelchesaurus were discovered in the Cañadón Calcáreo Formation in Chubut Province, Argentina.
facts.quote: Los restos fósiles de Tehuelchesaurus fueron descubiertos en la Formación Cañadón Calcáreo de la Provincia del Chubut, en la Argentina

facts.statement: The 50% complete skeleton (MPEF-PV 1125) includes 10 articulated presacral vertebrae, 4 sacral vertebrae, various ribs, right scapulocoracoid, right humerus, left radius and ulna, right ilium fragment, right pubis, left pubis fragment, left ischium, right ischial diaphysis, both femurs, and skin impressions.
facts.quote: Se ha encontrado el 50% del esqueleto, ejemplar MPEF-PV 1125, sin cráneo, que incluye 10 vértebras presacras articuladas más un elemento erosionado, 4 vértebras sacras, partes del yugo sacricostal, varias costillas, escapulacoracoideo derecho, húmero derecho, radio y cúbito izquierdos, fragmento de ilion derecho, pubis derecho y fragmento de pubis izquierdo, isquion izquierdo y diáfisis del isquion derecho, ambos fémures e impresiones cutáneas.

facts.statement: Indeterminate theropod teeth were found alongside the Tehuelchesaurus fossils.
facts.quote: Junto a estos además se hallaron dientes de un terópodo indeterminado.

facts.statement: The genus Tehuelchesaurus was named by Rich and colleagues in 1999.
facts.quote: PBDB name: Tehuelchesaurus (genus), Rich et al. 1999

facts.statement: Recent phylogenetic analysis places Tehuelchesaurus within Camarasauromorpha, related to Camarasaurus and Galveosaurus, but outside Titanosauriformes.
facts.quote: La última revisión filogenética lo relaciona con Camarasaurus y Galveosaurus dentro de Camarasauromorpha aunque fuera de Titanosauriformes.

facts.statement: Research indicates that Tehuelchesaurus forms a distinct clade with Galvesaurus.
facts.quote: Se vio que forma un clado con Galvesaurus.

facts.statement: The grouping of Tehuelchesaurus and Galvesaurus is supported by two unambiguous shared derived characteristics.
facts.quote: La monofilia de Tehuelchesaurus y Galvesaurus está respaldada por dos sinapomorfias inequívocas.

facts.statement: A unique feature of Tehuelchesaurus is that its dorsal neural spines are lateromedially narrow and anteroposteriorly elongated.
facts.quote: Las espinas neurales de estos taxones son lateromedialmente estrechas y anteroposteriormente alargadas.

facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus shares the trait of undivided spinopostzygapophyseal laminae with Galvesaurus.
facts.quote: El segundo carácter compartido por los dos taxones las laminas espinopostzigoapofisarias indivisas.

facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus possesses anterior dorsal ribs shaped like planks and a lateral protuberance on the proximal shaft of the femur.
facts.quote: costillas dorsales anteriores en forma de tablón y una protuberancia lateral en el eje proximal del fémur.

facts.statement: As a camarasauromorph, Tehuelchesaurus has an acromion process located near the midpoint of the scapular body and a puboischiadic contact reaching half the length of the pubis.
facts.quote: Sinapomorfias de Camarasauromorpha de Tehuelchesaurus incluyen un proceso de acromion de la escápula que se encuentra cerca del punto medio del cuerpo escapular y un contacto puboisquiático que alcanza la mitad de la longitud del pubis.

facts.statement: A possible derived trait in Tehuelchesaurus is the presence of sharp posterior pleurocoels on the anterior dorsal vertebrae.
facts.quote: Una posible sinapomorfia de los macronarios presentes en Tehuelchesaurus es la presencia de pleurocelos agudos posteriores en las vértebras dorsales anteriores.

facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus is considered a basal macronarian that is more derived than Europasaurus but falls outside the clade containing Tastavinisaurus, Janenschia, and advanced camarasauromorphs.
facts.quote: Tehuelchesaurus era un macronario basal más derivado que Europasaurus, pero fuera de un clado formado por Tastavinisaurus y Janenschia y camarasauromorfos superiores.

facts.statement: Tehuelchesaurus differs from Omeisaurus in the shape of the coracoid, radius, and ulna, as well as the pubis and ischium, and possesses dorsal vertebrae with deep pseudopleurocoels and opistocoelous centra, unlike Barapasaurus and Patagosaurus.
facts.quote: Se distingue de este último por la forma del coracoides, el radio y el cúbito, y las formas del pubis e isquion, todas las vértebras dorsales tienen los pseudopleurocoelos, depresiones profundas en los centros pero sin compartimientos internos y centros opistocoelos, diferente a los de Barapasaurus y Patagosaurus.

facts.statement: The placement of Tehuelchesaurus and Galvesaurus as camarasauromorphs more derived than Europasaurus is supported by shared traits including plank-shaped anterior dorsal ribs and a lateral femoral protuberance.
facts.quote: La posición de Tehuelchesaurus más Galvesaurus como camarasauromorfos que son más derivados que Europasaurus está respaldada por los siguientes caracteres sinapomórficos que están presentes en el taxón anterior, costillas dorsales anteriores en forma de tablón y una protuberancia lateral en el eje proximal del fémur.

rejected.statement: The species is known from holotype MPEF-PV 1125, a 50% complete skeleton lacking a skull but including vertebrae, limb parts, and skin impressions.
rejected.quote: known from the holotype MPEF-PV 1125 (Museo Paleontologico Egidio Fergulio), a 50% complete skeleton, lacking a skull, but including dorsal, sacral and caudal vertebrae, parts of the forelimbs and hindlimbs, parts of the shoulder girdle and pelvis, some rib fragments, and skin impressions.
